description: Return the ownership proof the user must publish for a host before active tests can run: the content of a file at /.well-known/mcp-authprobe.txt, or of a DNS TXT record. Use it when a scan reports ownership as not verified. The proof is a hash bound to the host; the configured secret itself is never returned. Sends no request. Fails if no secret is configured, and then says how to set one.

host.description: Bare host name of the MCP server, without scheme, port or path: mcp.example.com, not https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Use the host of the URL you will scan; an authorization server on another host needs its own proof.

name: ownership_proof
title: Ownership proof to publish
